<documents>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
Premium plan fee schedule
Here is every fee that can apply to a Premium account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $15.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $0.00 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $0.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 0% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $0.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $0.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | $10.00 |
| Incoming international wire | $0.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $0.00 |

## Details

Premium has no ATM fees from us, and we pay back ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 each month.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="atm-surcharges">
ATM owner surcharges and our fees
When you use an ATM outside BrookLink, up to two different charges can apply. They're easy to mix up.

## The ATM owner's surcharge

This is set by whoever owns the ATM, not by us. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm, and it's added to the withdrawal amount. For example, if you withdraw cash and the owner charges a surcharge, one transaction for the total appears in your activity.

## Tallowbrook's out-of-network fee

This is our fee, charged as a separate line called "Out-of-network ATM fee". It's $2.50 on Basic and on Plus after your free withdrawals, and free on Premium.

## Premium surcharge reimbursement

Premium pays back ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 per calendar month. The refund is credited automatically on the first business day of the next month.

## Avoiding both

Use a BrookLink ATM. They never charge a surcharge, and we never charge a fee for them.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="atm-fees-premium">
ATM fees on Premium
Here's what ATM withdrawals cost on the Premium plan.

| ATM | Tallowbrook fee |
|---|---|
| BrookLink, in the US | $0.00 |
| Any other ATM in the US | no fee |
| ATMs outside the US | free |

Premium also reimburses ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 each calendar month, in the US and abroad.

## Surcharges

ATM owners outside BrookLink can add their own surcharge on top of our fee. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm.

## Daily limit

You can withdraw up to $1,500 a day on Premium.

## Where fees show up

Any Tallowbrook ATM fee appears as its own line in your activity feed, right after the withdrawal, so you can always see what you paid us and what the ATM owner charged. The app's ATM map shows the nearest BrookLink ATMs.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: How much does Premium pay back for ATM surcharges?
